text:
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: release/nightwind-2026.03.21 -> 100% traffic in eu-west1, us-west1, apac1. Postdeploy smoke scheduled.

olivia: saw p95 synth spike in eu-west1 after rollout, started ~22:04 UTC. overall synth error rate up from 0.02% -> 0.8% :thinking_face:

sam: quick look at the logs shows a burst of prefix-cache misses from freshly started replicas, small prefill backoff. Not an OOM or model error. snippet: ```logs: warmup_miss_count=132 prefill_errors=0 latency_p95=820ms```

tasha: is this the short-burst traffic pattern we observed in the nightwind canary? we tuned warmup to 1x concurrency for the initial rollout window.

oncall-sre: customer-facing API p95 (prod) is stable, a handful of slow hits in support but no P1s yet. product-ops, can you confirm impact?

product-ops: support queue has 3 tickets mentioning slow responses around 22:10 UTC, all describe a single slow request then recovery. no active escalations.

olivia: plan suggestion — increase PREFILL_CONCURRENCY to 3x in eu-west1 only and re-run the synthetic smoke after a short delay. also shift synth probes to begin 5m after rollout to avoid measuring warmup churn.

sam: +1. proposed patch: ```kubectl -n inference set env deploy/nightwind PREFILL_CONCURRENCY=3 --region=eu-west1 && deploy-bot rerun-smoke --thread 1766129876 --delay 300```

deploy-bot: ack - scheduled smoke re-run in 5m. progressive rollout paused for apac1 and us-west1 until confirmation. :white_check_mark:

tasha: also add an ephemeral fallback route to the previous model variant for low-latency tier in eu-west1. toggle on automatically if synth error rate > 0.5% for 2 consecutive checks.

oncall-sre: I'll keep a watch on the check window. if errors persist after the re-run we should pin traffic back to the prior version and open a hotfix CR immediately.

sam: quick monitoring endpoint I used: ```GET /api/v1/health?route=nightwind&probe=synth&window=5m``` watch p95 and error_rate.

olivia: re-run results (after PREFILL_CONCURRENCY=3): eu-west1 p95 dropped to ~210ms, synth error_rate -> 0.03%. looks stable :party_parrot: Holding apac/us-west paused for +15m staged cadence.

product-ops: confirming — no new support tickets since 22:20. recommend lifting pause and continue staged rollout at +15m intervals.

deploy-bot: continuing rollout to apac1 in 15m. I will post a brief summary to #release-notes with the fix and postdeploy note. :rocket:
